question: What happens if planning permission is required?
guardrails: Do not state that planning permission is granted merely because an application has been submitted.
Do not state that an application is approved unless the official decision is identified.
Planning appeals and judicial review are different routes and must not be conflated.
Time limits must be calculated from the applicable decision/event and law version.
Public participation requirements depend on the application and statutory framework.
Conditions attached to permission must be analysed separately from the grant itself.
A planning permission does not automatically establish building-control compliance or title.
official_routes: An Coimisiún Pleanála / An Bord Pleanála where the applicable appeal or statutory route applies
